# Purpose

The purpose of this R script is to create and display a simple synthetic dataset. The script also calculates the average value from the dataset.

## Inputs

The script uses a small synthetic dataset containing three categories and their corresponding values.

## Outputs

The script displays the dataset and calculates the average value.

## R Code

```{r}
# Create a simple synthetic dataset
data <- data.frame(
  Category = c("A", "B", "C"),
  Value = c(10, 20, 15)
)

# Display the dataset
print(data)

# Calculate the average value
average_value <- mean(data$Value)

# Display the average value
print(average_value)
```
## Summary

This R script demonstrates a simple data analysis workflow. It creates a dataset, displays the data, and calculates an average value. The documentation explains the purpose, inputs, outputs, and main R code used in the analysis.
